messages:
Alex Chen: Quick sync — final deploy roster for next release train. Target window: Tue 09:00-11:00 PT. Need owners for each slot + smoke check signoffs. Ping if you need to swap.
Priya Nair: I can take the 09:00 slot (model-serving changes). Will run canary first then full.
Miguel Torres: I'll do 09:30-10:00 (console + telemetry), can run smoke dashboard after.
Samir Patel: I'll own 10:00-10:30 (dedicated infra + autoscale config). Will coordinate with infra on node drain.
Jen Lee: I'll be rollback owner and run the post-deploy quick tests. Adding crash-loop and latency checks.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window created: Tue 09:00-11:00 PT. Slots: 09:00 Priya, 09:30 Miguel, 10:00 Samir. Please confirm with :thumbsup:.
Alex Chen: @Priya can you confirm canary traffic percentage? Also add KV cache warmup step.
Priya Nair: Canary @10% for 15m, then 50% for 10m if green. Will run cache warmup script after canary.
Miguel Torres: I'll monitor console errors and roll back if error rate > 0.5% over 5m.
Samir Patel: Node drain command:
```bash
kubectl cordon <node>
kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```
Add to smoke checklist.
Jen Lee: Rollback plan: re-route traffic to previous model variant and revert autoscale patch. I have the previous manifests ready.
Alex Chen: Smoke checklist (copy into each slot's thread):
```text
- Health / Liveness ok
- End-to-end sample request
- Latency tail check (<99th 300ms)
- Error rate check (<0.5%)
- KV cache hit sanity
- Logs free of new WARN/ERROR spikes
```
Priya Nair: noted. I'll post canary metrics in this thread during my slot.
Miguel Torres: FYI I'll need someone to approve the console schema change PR before 08:30 to avoid delay. @Priya or @Alex?
Alex Chen: I'll take the PR review by 08:15.
release-coordinator: Noted — added to release calendar and notified on-call. Please update slot if any changes by EOD.
Samir Patel: Quick Q — if autoscale reverts during deploy, should we pause the rollout or continue?
Jen Lee: Pause rollout and escalate to oncall, unless it's a transient metric spike under 5m.
Alex Chen: Sounds good. Final ask: leave a :white_check_mark: in this thread when your slot is done and smoke green.
Priya Nair: ✅ starting canary at 09:00 PT.
Miguel Torres: ✅ console slot complete, smoke green.
Samir Patel: ✅ infra slot done, drains OK, no pod evictions errors.
Jen Lee: ✅ rollback checks pass, all good.
Alex Chen: Thanks team — closing the loop. :tada:
